subject: НСП: проверка отправителя №2
body:

acceptance: SPF/DKIM/DMARC results from received headers reviewed
no real purchase or customer order created

root_cause: Spam classification reason unknown pending received headers
next_step: Obtain received message properties: Authentication-Results, DKIM-Signature, Received and Return-Path; fix confirmed authentication or routing issue before closing deliverability.
